dialogues.speaker: Hulu
dialogues.text: It looks like liquid amber, and has just a hint of sweetness when it first hits the tongue...

dialogues.speaker: Hulu
dialogues.text: ...Followed shortly by a wonderful mellow aftertaste that lingers long after the fact. You won't find one better!

dialogues.speaker: Hulu
dialogues.text: And because we buy direct from Dawn Winery, we pass the savings right on to you...

response.speaker: Hulu
response.text: I—I don't think I... I definitely said this is a local Liyue wine...

response.speaker: Hulu
response.text: You said it alright, clear as day.

response.speaker: Hulu
response.text: ...I can tell from the look in your eyes that I am faced with an expert...

response.speaker: Hulu
response.text: Okay, I'll admit it. We buy from the Dawn Winery and change the labels.

response.speaker: Hulu
response.text: It's not like I want to lie, but the Dawn Winery's wines are second to none...

response.speaker: Hulu
response.text: N—Not interested? Come on, it's not every day you travel to Liyue, surely? Don't go home empty-handed...
